guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以「水力停留、氧化還原與季節性淨化」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
guides.conceptEn: Follow hydraulic residence, redox and seasonal treatment through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
procedure: 在「負荷與功能定位」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 8 kg/day，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只依面積比例增加進水可能超出氧與水力能力。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「孔隙水有效容積」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 105 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以總體積代替孔隙水體積會高估接觸時間。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「水力停留與短流」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 3 day，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「單點採樣可能漏掉高濃度短流。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「面積負荷與經驗模型」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 24.2612 mg/L，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「將另一氣候的係數直接搬用會失去校正依據。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「達西流與水位差」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 3 m3/day，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「忽略堵塞造成的K下降會低估水位。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「氮轉化與氧需求」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 9.14 kgO2/day，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「將總氮降低全歸因植物吸收會忽略微生物路徑。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「介質吸附容量」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1 kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以初期高去除外推多年會漏掉飽和。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「蒸散與降雨收支」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 48.5 m3/day，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只比較進出濃度會誤判稀釋或濃縮。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「沉積與維護週期」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.5 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「堵塞後才清理可能迫使系統旁通。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「季節驗證與生態目標」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.75 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以夏季最佳表現作全年保證會忽略低溫與暴雨。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
procedureEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for load and treatment function, first reproduce 8 kg/day, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Increasing feed by area ratio alone can exceed oxygen or hydraulic capacity." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for effective pore-water volume, first reproduce 105 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using bulk volume overstates contact time." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for residence time and short circuiting, first reproduce 3 day, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "A single sample may miss concentrated short-circuit flow." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for areal loading and empirical models, first reproduce 24.2612 mg/L, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Transferring a coefficient from another climate loses calibration support." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for darcy flow and head difference, first reproduce 3 m3/day, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Ignoring a clogging-induced reduction in K understates water level." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for nitrogen conversion and oxygen demand, first reproduce 9.14 kgO2/day, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Attributing all nitrogen loss to plant uptake ignores microbial pathways." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for media sorption capacity, first reproduce 1 kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Extrapolating high startup removal for years misses saturation." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for evapotranspiration and rainfall balance, first reproduce 48.5 m3/day, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Concentration-only comparison misreads dilution or concentration." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for sediment accumulation and maintenance, first reproduce 0.5 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Waiting for blockage can force system bypass." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for seasonal validation and ecological goals, first reproduce 0.75 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using summer best performance as an annual guarantee ignores cold and storm periods." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
evidence: 保持濃度，將流量加倍比較負荷。
改變孔隙率並比較停留時間。
比較多個出水口示蹤峰值與回收量。
比較面積加倍與流量減半的模型結果。
將導水係數減半並估所需水位差。
比較氧供給與氨氮負荷，找出限制環節。
用累積負荷估容量使用比例並比較出水突破。
把乾季與雨季水量及質量收支分開。
比較前處理去除率改變後的累積沉積量。
設計跨季節與暴雨事件採樣表，保留空缺原因。
evidenceEn: Keep concentration fixed and double flow to compare loading.
Vary porosity and compare residence time.
Compare tracer peaks and recovery at several outlets.
Compare doubled area with halved flow in the model.
Halve conductivity and estimate required head difference.
Compare oxygen supply with ammonia load to identify the limiting step.
Estimate capacity use from cumulative load and compare outlet breakthrough.
Separate dry-season and wet-season water and mass balances.
Compare sediment accumulation when pretreatment removal changes.
Design seasonal and storm-event sampling with reasons for gaps.
pitfalls: 只依面積比例增加進水可能超出氧與水力能力。
以總體積代替孔隙水體積會高估接觸時間。
單點採樣可能漏掉高濃度短流。
將另一氣候的係數直接搬用會失去校正依據。
忽略堵塞造成的K下降會低估水位。
將總氮降低全歸因植物吸收會忽略微生物路徑。
以初期高去除外推多年會漏掉飽和。
只比較進出濃度會誤判稀釋或濃縮。
堵塞後才清理可能迫使系統旁通。
以夏季最佳表現作全年保證會忽略低溫與暴雨。
pitfallsEn: Increasing feed by area ratio alone can exceed oxygen or hydraulic capacity.
Using bulk volume overstates contact time.
A single sample may miss concentrated short-circuit flow.
Transferring a coefficient from another climate loses calibration support.
Ignoring a clogging-induced reduction in K understates water level.
Attributing all nitrogen loss to plant uptake ignores microbial pathways.
Extrapolating high startup removal for years misses saturation.
Concentration-only comparison misreads dilution or concentration.
Waiting for blockage can force system bypass.
Using summer best performance as an annual guarantee ignores cold and storm periods.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 新加坡新生水系統
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。
courses.summaryEn: The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
